mapper.select: select retention_money_balance from ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base where supplier_shop_id = #{shopId}

select retention_money_balance as retentionMoneyBalance,retention_money_withdrawal as retentionMoneyWithdrawal, retention_money_payment as retentionMoneyPayment,retention_money_limit as retentionMoneyLimit,retention_status as retentionStatus , accumulated_compensation as accumulatedCompensation,user_id from ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base where supplier_shop_id = #{shopId}

select complaints_id,complaints_type,complaints_reason,complaints_voucher,complaints_contact,complaints_goodsid,seller_reason, complaints_status,compensation_amount,compensation_status,ooc.create_time,revoke_num,order_id,ooc.user_id, failure_time,seller_voucher,ooc.shop_id,shop_name FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints ooc left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base gmsb on gmsb.supplier_shop_id = ooc.shop_id where 1 = 1 and ooc.user_id = #{param.userId} and id = #{param.id}

SELECT compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, ooc.create_time, complaints_contact, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, sb.shop_name, ui.user_name, ooc.shop_id, sb.retention_money_limit, sb.retention_money_balance, ooc.user_id, ooc.complaints_voucher, ooc.seller_voucher, ooc.seller_reason FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints ooc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON ooc.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui ON ooc.user_id = ui.user_id WHERE id = #{param.id}

SELECT compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, ooc.create_time, complaints_contact, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, sb.shop_name, ui.user_name, ooc.shop_id, sb.retention_money_limit, sb.retention_money_balance, ooc.user_id, ooc.complaints_voucher, ooc.seller_voucher, ooc.seller_reason FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints ooc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON ooc.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui ON ooc.user_id = ui.user_id WHERE complaints_id = #{param}
select avg_servicecredit,avg_deliverycredit,avg_desccredit from ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_avg_evaluation where shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT retention_money_balance AS retentionMoneyBalance, retention_money_withdrawal AS retentionMoneyWithdrawal, retention_money_payment AS retentionMoneyPayment, retention_money_limit AS retentionMoneyLimit, retention_status AS retentionStatus, accumulated_compensation AS accumulatedCompensation, sb.user_id, sb.supplier_shop_id, ui.user_mobile FROM ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui ON ui.user_id = sb.user_id WHERE sb.supplier_shop_id = #{shopId}
select count(1) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints where order_id = #{orderId} and user_id = #{userId}

SELECT sum(a) END FROM ( ( SELECT sum( compensation_amount ) AS a FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints WHERE shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{param.start} and #{param.end} and complaints_status = 1 ) ) AS find

SELECT id, compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, create_time, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, user_id, shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} and compensation_status = 0 and complaints_status = 1
ORDER BY create_time DESC
select count(1) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints where shop_id = #{shopId} and complaints_status = #{complaintsStatus}

SELECT compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, create_time, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, user_id, complaints_voucher, complaints_contact, seller_voucher, seller_reason FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints WHERE complaints_id = #{complaintsId}

SELECT compensation_amount, complaints_id, complaints_type, complaints_reason, order_id, create_time, fund_destination, complaints_goodsid, complaints_status, failure_time, user_id, complaints_voucher, complaints_contact, seller_voucher, seller_reason FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints WHERE id = #{complaintsId}

select oc.order_id,ob.buyer_user_id as user_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_complaints oc left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob on ob.order_id = oc.order_id where complaints_id = #{complaintsId}
